headline: FULL STACK
DEVELOPER.
hero.bio: Computer Science student, in his final year, with hands on experience in web and mobile development. I use React, React Native, Node and AI to turn a business problem into a working product, from requirements gathering to deploy.
principles: Simple on the outside, solid on the inside
Business and technology in the same sentence
AI integrated into the process, not just talk

heading: THE BRIDGE BETWEEN
BUSINESS AND CODE
about.body: Before writing code I try to understand the problem. That view comes from working as a business analyst, combined with hands on full stack development. The result is a way of working that goes through requirements gathering, architecture and user experience before a single line of code, with AI applied through most of the process.

differentiators.title: BUSINESS VISION
differentiators.description: Requirements gathering before architecture. Understanding the process avoids technical rework later.

differentiators.title: APPLIED AI
differentiators.description: AI integrated into the development cycle, from modeling to code, to speed up delivery without losing quality.

differentiators.title: PRODUCT, NOT JUST CODE
differentiators.description: UX, scalability and maintenance are part of the technical decision, not an afterthought.

heading: MY WORKING
PROCESS
process.intro: Ten steps between understanding the problem and watching the solution run in production.

steps.title: PROBLEM
steps.description: Understand the real problem before any solution.

steps.title: REQUIREMENTS GATHERING
steps.description: Talk to the people who live the process and map what actually matters.

steps.title: SOLUTION MODELING
steps.description: Design the flow before designing the screen.

steps.title: UX
steps.description: Simplicity for the user, even when the logic behind it is complex.

steps.title: ARCHITECTURE
steps.description: Technical decisions made for scale and maintenance, not just the deadline.

steps.title: DEVELOPMENT
steps.description: Clean, typed and testable code, without over engineering.

steps.title: AI TO ACCELERATE
steps.description: AI in the process to gain speed, without giving up critical review.

steps.title: TESTING
steps.description: Validate before the user has to validate it for me.

steps.title: DEPLOY
steps.description: Ship with CI/CD and a simple rollback, no drama.

steps.title: MONITORING
steps.description: Watch the system in production, not just ship and forget.

items.name: LUMA
items.subtitle: FemTech focused on women's health
items.problem: Few digital tools designed for continuous, accessible tracking of women's health.
items.solution: Platform built from scratch: architecture, frontend, backend and AI.
items.challenge: Designing a UX sensitive to the topic and modeling health data with privacy as a priority.

items.name: HOTEL MARAZUL
items.subtitle: Hotel management system
items.problem: Small and medium hotels depend on spreadsheets and manual processes.
items.solution: Hotel management system, from reservations to daily operations.
items.challenge: Translating real hotel workflows into simple screens.

items.name: GLPI MOBILE
items.subtitle: IT asset manager
items.problem: Manual IT asset control, without centralized visibility for the team.
items.solution: React Native app integrated with GLPI for mobile asset management.
items.challenge: Integration with the GLPI API and reliable data synchronization.

items.name: SUS CARD READER
items.subtitle: OCR for SUS card identification
items.problem: Manual entry of the SUS card number causes errors and delays in service.
items.solution: Application with OCR that reads the card number directly from a photo.
items.challenge: Keeping accuracy under real camera and lighting conditions.
